title: Three moves
summary: Li Xuantong opens with the Lingxuan Jade Palm, the move that made him famous, and Mu Chen blocks it with the Senluo Death Mark and the pagoda. Li Xuantong's second move is the Yixuan Finger of his Divine-category Tianxuan Divine Art, which Mu Chen meets with the White Tiger Divine Seal of the Constellation Sutra of Four Gods. For the third move Mu Chen asks to attack, builds the Level 4 Demon Lotus Spirit-Slaying Formation from spiritual seals, and breaks through Li Xuantong's Tianxuan Compass, so Li Xuantong concedes. Afterwards Li Xuantong tells him about Luo Li's burden: she is heir of the declining Luo race, one of the four divine races of the Western Heavenly Realm, and her dying grandfather Luo Tianshen will call her back within five years to take the inheritance and try for the Sovereign Stage. He also mentions Flame Emperor, the lower-world man whose help once saved the Luo race. Mu Chen promises Luo Li he will become as strong as Flame Emperor.
